name: JV_GENERATED_TRANSACTIONS
description: This table contains the joint venture internally generated transactions such as overhead that do not come from the general ledger or subledger accounting.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture generated transaction.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOINT_VENTURE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture that is associated with the internally generated transaction.

columns.name: HEADER_ID
columns.description: Header defining column for the transaction.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Accounting line for the transaction.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. A value of -10568 will be used to identify this transaction as originating from joint ventures.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code of the joint venture transaction. It is based on the ORA_JV_GEN_TRANSACTION_STATUS lookup codes such as available to process, process complete, error, or on hold.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date used to identify when the joint venture generated transaction occurred.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: The source of the joint venture generated transaction. It is based on ORA_JV_GEN_TRANSACTION_SOURCE lookup codes such as overhead.

columns.name: OVERHEAD_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture overhead method that is associated with the internally generated transaction.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: DEBIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: The debit amount of the joint venture generated transaction.

columns.name: CREDIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: The credit amount of the joint venture generated transaction.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code of the joint venture generated transaction.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Key flexfield combination defining column that will be used as the receivable offset account in invoicing.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OWNER_DEFINITION_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: The ownership definition short name to be used to distribute the transaction amount among stakeholders. This can be overridden from what was originally assigned. This name references the OWNERSHIP_PERCENT_SHORT_NAME column in the jv_owner_percents_f_b table.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the stakeholder that is to be directly billed for the transaction. This can be overridden from what was originally assigned.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The distribution type that will be used to determine the accounting when the distributed source transaction is billed. It is based on the ORA_JV_GEN_DISTRIBUTION_TYPE lookup codes such as overhead, fees, cost, or revenue.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Source transaction accounting date.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Fiscal period that the source transaction is associated with.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: A description that is passed into the joint venture invoice for the source transaction.

columns.name: NOTES
columns.description: Additional notes about the source transaction.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the project that is associated with the source transaction.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the project task that is associated with the source transaction.

columns.name: EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the expenditure type that is associated with the source transaction.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
